comments: 41132e2c: This program is responsible for updating patient movement records in the VistA system.
e2bb87c1: Initialize variables and set DGONE flag to indicate processing has started.
bd8b71d8: Flag to ensure that the 'Updating incomplete records...' message is only displayed once.
1caca2f8: Loop through the patient movement types of interest and process each.
71dc9c6a: Clean up variables and quit the routine.
94ad8e9f: End of the EN2 entry point.
10c7ae46: START handles the logic for updating or creating new patient movement records.
664b8d5a: Set CA to the parent movement if present, otherwise use the current movement's parent.
b505d0a5: Determine the movement type from either the previous or current movement record.
4a1527f9: If it's an admission without a corresponding discharge, update incomplete records.
e0e163ae: Display message about updating records if this is the first run and not in quiet mode.
4b1dc4d2: Ensure message about updating incomplete records is shown only once.
37371ed1: Call DIK to delete orphaned records.
3f772026: Fetch ward information for the patient.
5803c285: Set division based on ward information if available.
7f38ea2e: Quit if division is not defined or inactive.
c7987c58: Display updating records message if first run and not in quiet mode, then reset flag.
a3ee0e7c: Check if there are special infection movements and get the first one if present.
1f018286: Call DIS to process the discharge or special infection flag.
64d9cce9: Loop through and delete any entries in the VAS(393 file associated with the admission.
d547cc0e: Clean up variables after deletion.
5437dc15: DIS handles the logic for discharges or special infection flag updates.
6f3fd896: Initialize the DR variable for use in building dynamic DIE strings.
abe5ac3b: Set DGJTADM to the admission related to this movement, quit if not found.
11ba6567: Loop through VAS(393 entries related to the admission to find a match.
d199a159: If a matching entry is found, set DGJTDA to that entry's IEN.
a56de695: If the movement type is transfer and conditions are met, call CHNG to update records.
d34d01a5: Handle new or updated admissions and transfers, including creating new records or updating existing ones.
06b57fda: Delete the existing record if the movement is an admission with no previous movement and a matching entry is found.
28e7c93d: For admissions or transfers with a change, handle updating the record.
d89d9fec: Handle transfers where the previous movement differs, updating the related record.
6ff41b08: For special infection flag movements, create a new record if necessary.
dc0b68d2: Quit if the movement type is 3 (special infection flag) and other conditions are not met.
3950b482: Set DGJTCA to I if there's a corresponding admission and the movement type is 1.
3bf5d4da: Change the record if there's a special infection flag and the previous and current movements differ.
72ee6368: Update the record if the special infection flag matches but the ward differs.
7c9454be: Clean up variables related to discharge processing.
b96e53ef: NEW creates a new patient movement record in VAS(393) based on current or parent movement.
bbcaa8b5: Set DGJT to the most recent related admission date for the patient.
003936cf: Retrieve division treatment parameters.
c8b796f1: Set ward location based on DGJTWARD.
80a6c453: Determine service connected to the ward.
4b7c0a70: Set service variable, defaulting to 0 if not found.
8c84f29b: Prepare document type data for the 'Incomplete Record' entry.
062e8940: Set additional document type data based on division parameters.
d372d185: Quit processing if the movement type is 6 or 2.
8823ff76: Skip file creation if DGJTCA is already set.
793f8fdb: Create a new file entry in VAS(393) for the patient.
64db8615: Set the status of the new record to 'INCOMPLETE'.
e02fe899: Prepare the new record for data population.
c3b947cc: Populate the new record with relevant data.
0def0681: Finalize the new record creation by executing the DIE command.
73934e3f: Call DISQ to clean up variables and quit the NEW process.
c1d07288: Set ward and division in the record for certain movement types.
b340475c: Update the record with additional data.
a1061950: Call DISQ to clean up variables after processing.
b54f525f: End of the FILE process.
84f43d29: DOC sets up document type related data.
a02f53ea: Retrieve the parameter based on the document type.
f839ffb4: Set the document type based on division parameters.
ff45c4fd: End of the DOC subroutine.
c9455d00: CHNG updates an existing patient movement record.
c11b0ecf: Check if the patient movement entry is valid and has no discharge.
add86427: Set DGJTTM to the admission time if there's a corresponding discharge.
a89280cb: Update the record with the admission time.
